scope: A complete author proof in the supplied-fibration bounded scope: for every surjective holomorphic pi:X->B between connected smooth compact Kaehler manifolds, dim X=n>nu=dim B>=1, beta Kaehler on B, theta=pi*beta, and m=n-nu, pi_*(omega^m)=c_omega>0 globally. For every bounded beta-psh phi and every bounded (theta+epsilon omega)-psh u_epsilon with ||u_epsilon-pi*phi||_infinity->0, pi_*((theta+epsilon omega+ddc u_epsilon)^n)/(binom(n,nu)c_omega epsilon^m) converges weakly to (beta+ddc phi)^nu, of raw mass int_B beta^nu. This includes critical/dimension-jumping fibres and non-descending perturbative potentials with no epsilon-relative rate, all auxiliary Kaehler classes after their respective calibrations, smoothly converging auxiliary paths with Kaehler limit, the associated bounded base energy and its cocycle/segment variational/monotonicity/concavity/shift laws, and compensating changes of beta representative. It is partial to the original P15.2, not an independently verified draft or a literature-priority claim.
limitations: The original general pseudoeffective zero-volume P15.2 remains open: no supplied holomorphic fibration or pulled-back Kaehler representative is available in general.
The proof does not construct a canonical carrier from alpha or prove minimality/independence of the supplied carrier, fibration, and base reference class.
No prescribed unbounded P-type or E1 extension, arbitrary degenerate auxiliary path, or merely nonuniform potential convergence is treated.
